summary: Relaxing adult colouring book with 3000+ stunning pictures and gorgeous colours
description:
Unwind and express your creativity with the ultimate adult coloring experience. Our collection of over 3000 beautifully detailed professional illustrations gives you endless inspiration, from intricate florals and majestic animals to mesmerizing sea creatures and stunning mandalas.

Whether you have five minutes to spare or hours to lose yourself in, mindful coloring is the perfect way to de-stress, focus your mind, and create something beautiful.

🎨 Paint your way
Fill areas with a single tap, or switch to brush mode for freehand strokes. Choose from an unlimited color palette and adjust your brush width from fine detail to bold strokes. Made a mistake? Simply undo or erase, no picture is ever ruined.

🖼️ Share your masterpieces
Finished a picture you're proud of? Share it to the in-app gallery, collect likes, and discover what other artists are creating. Leave comments, follow your favorite creators, and get inspired.

🌟 Why you'll love it
• 3000+ high-definition pictures across dozens of themed packs
• 60+ free pictures to get started, no subscription required
• Tap-to-fill and freehand brush modes
• Unlimited color palettes with a color picker and pipette tool
• Multiple brush widths from precision detail to giant strokes
• Unlimited undo and a dedicated eraser
• Left-handed mode for comfortable drawing
• Share to the community gallery and receive feedback
• Tablet support with optimized layouts
• Dark mode support
• No time limits, color at your own pace

Coloring is designed for adults. The pictures are intricate and detailed, offering a satisfying challenge that simple coloring apps can't match. Not suitable for children.

Download now and start your coloring journey today.

Permissions used:
- 'In-app purchases' to offer optional picture packs for purchase
- 'Photos/Media/Files' to save your finished pictures to your device gallery
